title: Road to bigger legs update (26.5 inches)
summary: Short leg-size check-in: thighs grew from 26 to 26.5 inches on the way to a 28-inch goal. Strength rose on deadlift, squat, RDL, good mornings and SSB box squats; the hamstrings developed most, now showing a sweep from behind.

claims.claim: His thigh grew almost half an inch, from 26 to 26.5 inches, with both legs about equal; the goal is 28 inches.
Over the same period his deadlift went up 40 lb, squat 10 lb, RDL 20 lb, good mornings 30 lb and safety-bar box squats 50 lb.

numbers.load: DL +40, squat +10, RDL +20, GM +30, SSB box squat +50 lb

claims.claim: Heavy deadlifting grew his hamstrings a lot as he expected; hamstrings developed most and now show a sweep from behind, while quads stayed roughly the same.
His plan is to keep grinding squats and deadlifts toward 28 inches, with the next update at 27.
